design: Single dataset + boundary metadata (PLAN v2.0.5 §4.2). Loader uses these epiweek ranges to filter; lookback windows cross boundaries (predictors only).

val.description: Val: W40-2018 ~ W10-2020 (truncate at COVID onset)

covid_excluded.description: COVID hole: W11-2020 ~ W39-2020 — neither val nor test

test_post_covid_DEPRECATED_v2_0_4.description: DEPRECATED (v2.0.4 spec): Test w/o COVID = 2021-22 ~ 2024-25 (204 rows). Superseded by 'test_strict' in v2.1.7-A++ (PLAN §4.1) because 2021-22 std=0.70 is anomalous. Field kept temporarily for backward-compat; do NOT use for new evaluations.

test_strict.description: Test_strict (v2.1.7-A++, PLAN §4.1): W40-2022 ~ W35-2025 (152 rows = 3 post-recovery seasons 2022-23 / 2023-24 / 2024-25). Excludes both 2020-21 (NPI strong suppression) and 2021-22 (atypical timing, std=0.70). Subset of 'test' (Test_full).

_v2_1_7_A_pp_notes: v2.1.7-A++ COVID exclusion update: literature-backed strict mask (CDC FluSight About + Olsen 2020 MMWR + Merced-Morales 2022 MMWR + Adlhoch 2021 + Melidou 2022 Eurosurveillance + Borchering 2024 Nature Communications). See PLAN.md §4.1.
